leah: initial hypothesis: prefetch change increased KV cache working set; combined with larger-than-expected batch defaults and an autoscaler metric rename, resulted in memory pressure and slower scale-up. logging agent restart created audit gap.
kim: autoscaler metric rename was intended to be backwards-compatible, but seems we missed a tag in the mapping. opening RI ticket now.
kim: action items being created in tracker:
- INC-2003334444-1: revert prefetch heuristics and enforce batch cap (assignee: kim)

- SEC-980-A: evidence collection + KMS log pull + IAM change history (assignee: samir)
- INC-2003334444-3: add post-recovery audit continuity check to runbook (assignee: leah)

Produce evidence manifest with SHA256 checksums. Deadline 2026-07-22.

- mitigation steps: rollback (11:18), batch-throttle (11:20), fallback routing (11:22), metrics baseline back ~11:33
